title: One point of contact
text: Forwarding, clearing, trucking and storage handled by one team, so you never chase three companies for one shipment.

title: Clear pricing
text: Duties, fees and transport itemised before you commit. What we quote is what you pay.

title: You always know where it is
text: Status updates from collection to delivery, and a driver's number you can call on the road.

title: Port-side in Tema
text: Minutes from Tema Port and the GPHA offices — paperwork gets walked through, not posted.
